page.notes: Left edge strip shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The Greek in the text (1 Cor. 10:6) is a doubtful reading from the scan: the first words are read as εἰς τὸ μὴ εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἐπιθυμητὰς κακῶν, with the middle partly obscured. The marginal note word "sitando" (for vitando) is uncertain. The verse quotation is set as one paragraph and the attribution is kept with it.
